palettes.name: Forest & Leaf
palettes.note: Our recommendation: familiar agriculture, with a deeper, calmer green.

palettes.name: River & Forest
palettes.note: Closest to the original blue-and-green identity, with restrained saturation.

palettes.name: Olive & Sage
palettes.note: A softer, earthy alternative that feels natural and established.

palettes.name: Forest & Gold
palettes.note: Warm harvest color brings a more food-focused accent.

options.name: Familiar Canopy
options.note: The mark you liked: a broad green canopy, simple arched badge and a clear white drop. The closest starting point for refinement.

options.name: Open Canopy
options.note: The extra gateway is gone. A simple green canopy sits above a clear water drop — two shapes, the same story, without the filled badge.

options.name: Grounded Canopy
options.note: The familiar canopy and drop sit above a separated foundation. It recalls the original name band, with the lettering moved into a legible wordmark.

options.name: Sheltered Canopy
options.note: A gently rising leaf edge gives the canopy more movement. The round-tipped water drop stays centered within the same recognizable arched outline.
